message.content: {"reexplain":"When one function sits inside another, differentiate the outside first but leave the inside untouched, then multiply by the derivative of the inside. For sin(x^2), the outside gives cos(x^2) and the inside gives 2x, so the answer is cos(x^2) times 2x.","mcq":{"q":"What is the derivative of sin(x^2)?","options":["cos(x^2)","cos(x^2) * 2x","cos(2x)","2x * sin(x^2)"],"answerIdx":1,"why":"The outer derivative cos is evaluated at the inside, x^2, then multiplied by the inner derivative 2x. Stopping at cos(x^2) forgets the inner factor."}}
